newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea seeks open market in 21st century.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea seeks open market in 21st century.

text.p: The South Korean government has set a national agenda that would shift policies toward creating an open market economy in preparation for the 21st century, a finance ministry statement said on Friday.

President Kim Young-sam, economic-related ministers and the central Bank of Korea governor were to meet on Friday to discuss such issues as making the government more consumer-oriented and promoting fair competition among corporations and corporate transparency in the 21st century.
The agenda also included introducing flexibility in economic and social policies, improving infrastructure and promoting information and innovation.
The government would come up with measures to pursue its goals, the statement said.
